column1: # note: Liftoff v1.6.3 (conda env liftoff; its minimap2 2.24), self-lift of each genome's RefSeq gene + pseudogene records: -copies -sc 0.95 -a 0.5 -s 0.5 -overlap 0.1 -p 4 -f pseudogene; default -mm2_options (-a --end-bonus 5 --eqx -N 50 -p 0.5)
# note: run as one Liftoff call per contig's records (blocks of <= 2500 records) against the WHOLE genome; cross-call overlaps resolved by Liftoff's own rule (prereg §1 M1-M3)

# note: V-L1 (mini-genome chr20-22, one Liftoff run vs per-contig calls and vs blocks of records; prereg amendment 3): B_contigs: 3740 of 3750 annotated placements identical, 439 of 448 extra copies identical (Jaccard 0.9799) -> FAIL: reported as an approximation of one run; C_blocks: 3730 of 3750 annotated placements identical, 438 of 449 extra copies identical (Jaccard 0.9755) -> FAIL: reported as an approximation of one run
# note: matching (prereg §3): cov(G|R) = |exons(G) ∩ exons(R)| / |exons(G)| >= 0.5, same contig, strand ignored; in one genome Liftoff's sequence_ID of a coordinate match equals its coverage

# note: human: 58563 records in 36 calls; cross-call merge dropped 9958 copies overlapping another call's annotated locus (M1) and 884 overlapping copies (M2); 24 annotated overlaps kept (M3); 0 anomalies

# note: gorilla: 41193 records in 28 calls; cross-call merge dropped 10062 copies overlapping another call's annotated locus (M1) and 868 overlapping copies (M2); 0 annotated overlaps kept (M3); 0 anomalies

# note: chimpanzee: 41815 records in 27 calls; cross-call merge dropped 8043 copies overlapping another call's annotated locus (M1) and 880 overlapping copies (M2); 0 annotated overlaps kept (M3); 0 anomalies

# note: orangutan: 37517 records in 29 calls; cross-call merge dropped 5482 copies overlapping another call's annotated locus (M1) and 551 overlapping copies (M2); 0 annotated overlaps kept (M3); 0 anomalies

# note: cls: in_place = placed on its own record (same contig, reciprocal span overlap >= 0.5); moved = placed elsewhere; partial = Liftoff's partial_mapping / low_identity; unmapped; extra_copy = -copies (unannotated by construction); dropped_M1/M2 = removed by the cross-call rule
# note: size: exon union >= 200 bp (ge200, scored for Rustle) or < 200 bp (lt200, reported only); sc_min: extra copies with sequence_ID >= sc_min (filters of the -sc 0.95 run)
